title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-15
content:
Purpose: prep notes + decisions for weekly exec staff sync on 2026-03-15. Keep tight, focus on: 1) reliability/cost tradeoffs for Hosted API, 2) Dedicated capacity expansion ask, 3) Private deployment roadmap timeline.

Attendees (tentative): Asha (me), Ben, Maya, Diego, Priya (finance), Omar (SRE), Lee (sales lead) - confirm.

Top-of-mind metrics (quick snapshot)
- Hosted API: 99.93% uptime last 7d (SRE target 99.95%) - incidents: 2 brief zone failovers.
- p95 gen latency: 210ms global (target 180ms for tier-1 customers).
- Token cost (infra-only, 1k tokens): $0.27 avg this week (target < $0.22 with batching + q2 optimizations).
- Dedicated backlog: 8 booked contracts, 3 pending legal.

Agenda draft (30m total)
1) Quick metrics + incident highlights (5m) - Omar
2) Hosted cost/latency plan (10m) - Ben + SRE input
   - Proposal: roll out new batching profile + quantization change for 2 models by Apr 1. Expected token cost -12%, p95 +30ms risk.
   - Decision needed: approve canary on production vs opt-in customer pilot.
3) Dedicated capacity ask (7m) - Maya + Priya
   - Sales requests extra 24 GPUs to meet committed throughput for new customer cohort. Budget impact: +$120k/mo OPEX.
   - Options: reserve from partner pool (short-term) or fast-track procurement (30-45d).
4) Private deploy roadmap alignment (5m) - Diego
   - Air-gapped package release window slip: target moved from May 15 -> Jun 7. Need sign-off on communication plan.
5) AOB / decisions recap (3m)

Key talking points / notes to self
- Keep Hosted API discussion framed in unit economics: show cost delta + customer SLA implications. Bring 1 pager with example customer (e-comm) cost model.
- For batching proposal: have rollback plan and signal thresholds for aborting canary (error rate >0.5% or p95 >300ms).
- Emphasize Dedicated ask as revenue-protecting, not discretionary. Priya needs ARR cadence to justify OPEX.
- Private deploy slip: distinguish engineering risk vs compliance review lag. Propose customer comms template (apology + new timeline + mitigation).

Blockers / open items before meeting
- Ben: get exact expected cost savings numbers by model and by traffic tier (urgent, needed by EOD 3/14).
- SRE: draft canary monitoring dashboard link and SLO abort thresholds.
- Sales: list top 3 customers impacted if Dedicated procurement delayed >45d.
- Legal: confirm any contract language implications for shifting Dedicated timelines.

Decisions we should be ready to make
- Approve production canary for batching/quantization (Y/N) + guardrails?
- Approve short-term 24 GPU reservation from partner pool (Y/N) pending procurement timeline?
- Approve new customer comms for Private slip (align on tone + credit offering)?

Follow-up action items (owner - due)
- Ben Carter - Prepare cost delta spreadsheet (by model + traffic tier) and 1-pager for execs - due 2026-03-14 EOD.
- Omar (SRE) - Canary dashboard + SLO abort playbook + runbook link - due 2026-03-14 noon.
- Priya (Finance) - Impact note on OPEX vs revenue protection for 24 GPU ask; include ARR math - due 2026-03-15 AM.
- Maya (Sales) - Customer impact list + suggested prioritization for capacity allocation - due 2026-03-14.
- Diego (Private) - Draft customer comms template and mitigation offer (credit/discount) - due 2026-03-15.
- Asha (me) - Finalize agenda + slide deck (3 slides: metrics, decision table, next steps) - due 2026-03-14 EOD.

Notes style / reminders
- Keep slides minimal, data-backed. Execs want clear ask + consequence of do-nothing.
- If canary deferred, propose immediate pilot with 2 low-risk customers first.
- Record meeting notes in Confluence page (link above) and ping CS for customer comms support.

Open questions to surface in meeting
- If quantization increases hallucination risk, do we have evals that can detect quality regressions quickly? Who owns that signal?
- Are any enterprise customers on annual commits likely to churn if Dedicated delays >45d? (need concrete names)

Rough script (for me)
- 0:00 start - state purpose + timebox.
- Metrics brief - highlight improvements but call out gaps.
- Ask 1: Approve canary with guardrails. Present numbers succinctly.
- Ask 2: Approve temporary GPU reservation to avoid revenue loss. Show finance note.
- Ask 3: Align on customer comms for Private slip.

Easy wins / parking lot
- Quick win: roll out batching tuning to non-prod first and measure.
- Parking lot: deeper look at kernel selection profiling for next quarter (tag: infra-performance).

End-of-doc TODO (personal)
- Confirm attendee list with Priya and Lee.
- Slack reminder for collaborators at 9am on meeting day.
- Upload final slides to Confluence and link in calendar invite.

---
Informal notes (scratch):
- Might push some of the technical back-and-forth to a follow-up deep dive w/ infra + SRE to keep exec meeting short.
- Keep an eye on market messaging re: reliability - competitors just announced lower latency numbers; we must avoid being reactive.
